result.short_description: Checkout API latency spike after risk service release
result.description: Checkout p95 latency exceeded 800ms (SLO: 450ms) starting 18:12 UTC. Root cause: unbounded retry fan-out to the Risk Decision API after release 2026.10.1 introduced a timeout regression. Authorization throughput dropped 40%.
result.resolution_notes: Reduced retry fan-out and enabled bounded safe fallback via SHOP-302 emergency hotfix. p95 recovered to 180ms within 50 minutes.

result.short_description: Payment authorization timeout for high-value orders
result.description: Orders above 5000 USD are timing out at the payment gateway during peak hours. The gateway rate limit is being hit due to retry amplification from the checkout service.
result.resolution_notes: Resolved as duplicate of INC0071042. Retry reduction in SHOP-302 eliminated the gateway rate limit breach.

result.short_description: Emergency: deploy bounded risk timeout fallback
result.description: Deploy the SHOP-302 hotfix to production to reduce retry amplification and enable the bounded safe fallback for risk service timeouts. Emergency change approved by Commerce SRE lead.

result.short_description: Scheduled: migrate inventory reservation to async model
result.description: Deploy SHOP-304 async inventory reservation with 15-minute expiry. Expected to reduce checkout p95 by 80ms by eliminating synchronous inventory lock.
